sources: 2025 annual report: mechanisms and acquired rights
gaps: No complete company-reported phase totals were verified; counts is null.
Sutimlimab's current numbered phase in ITP was not established. The November presentation plans Phase 3 initiation for early 2027, which is not an ongoing Phase 3 trial.

mRNA-3927 Phase 2 is stated by Moderna's May 28, 2026 pipeline, before June 2026. The November Recordati presentation confirms registrational-study results expected by year-end without assigning a numbered phase.
Zilganersen was removed because Ionis confirms US approval in its November 9, 2026 results; Recordati's remaining plans are regional submissions for the same indication.
The April 2026 annual report predates June 2026 and supports mechanisms and acquired rights only; current milestones come from November 2026.
Antisense and mRNA therapies use modality other because the required vocabulary has no dedicated category.
